caption: The drawing features a rectangular musical instrument that resembles a spinet or early piano, constructed mainly from a reddish-brown wood with visible grain patterns and detailed golden trim inlays. The instrument has a lid that is partially open, revealing a yellowish-gold interior facing panel decorated with a central oval motif and surrounded by small ornate details. Below this panel, there is a visible keyboard with alternating white and black keys. The instrument stands on four tapered legs, each with additional horizontal wooden supports. At each upper corner, where the legs meet the body of the instrument, there are decorative golden circular accents. The drawing includes a separate rectangular insert below the instrument illustration, showing a black-and-white stylized label with floral decorations and the text “MAKER, Philadelphia” inside an ornate border. The entire composition is set against a plain light beige background.
title: Piano
